title: Fast-write Mirror views with slow consolidation
hypothesis: A temporary low-description functional view can be consolidated into a shared slow basis while preserving previously written functions at lower complete serialized state than retaining private fast adapters, and it can beat native shared low-rank consolidation on held-out outputs.
physical_object: Shared base linear operator plus an incrementally consolidated low-rank update basis
mirror_coordinate: Per-task fast update coordinates, remapped when new basis directions are consolidated
logical_multiplicity: 32 task functions retained across four consolidation boundaries

task.metric: Held-out input-output NRMSE for every retained task; actual complete payload bytes at each consolidation boundary; update and decode MAC proxies

development.selection_metric: Mean across tasks of output NRMSE, complete serialized bytes, and old-task drift immediately before/after consolidation

controls: Private fast rank-2 task deltas with no consolidation
Native shared rank-4 update basis with ordinary task coefficient vectors and the same consolidation schedule
Mirror coordinate-coded update basis with identical reconstruction operations
Native PCA of consolidated task deltas
compute: actual serialization and isolated wall time
success_gate: At residual 0 and both task counts, all historical tasks have mean and worst-task NRMSE <=0.02 after each consolidation; complete payload is <=60% of independent matrices and <=80% of private rank-2 adapters; Mirror strictly beats native shared-low-rank control in quality/bytes without more than 10% decode MAC overhead.
failure_gate: Any quality or byte gate fails, or Mirror exactly aliases native shared low-rank/PCA state and outputs. If development shows exact alias or clear gate failure, fresh may remain sealed and the scoped FAIL is recorded.
boundaries: Synthetic linear tasks only; not a ReLoRA or Titans reproduction
Each task's target operator and held-out input set are fixed per world
The consolidation transition must preserve every previously written task or record its drift
All state including task IDs, codes and reconstruction metadata is charged
Fresh worlds are never used to alter rank, interval, residual or metric
